lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ke tu kya hai
couplets.en: Whatever I say, you ask, what are you?

lines: Tum hi kaho ke ye andaaz-e-guftagu kya hai
couplets.en: Tell me yourself, what kind of talk is this?

lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ke tu kya hai

lines: Jala hai jism jahaan, dil bhi jal gaya hoga
couplets.en: Where the body burned, the heart must have burned too.

lines: Kuredte ho jo ab raakh, justuju kya hai
couplets.en: What are you looking for now, sifting through the ashes?

lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ke tu kya hai

lines: Na shole mein ye karishma, na barq mein ye ada
couplets.en: Neither flame nor lightning has such grace.

lines: Koi batao ke woh shokh-e-tund-khu kya hai
couplets.en: Can anyone tell me what to make of that fierce beauty?

lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ke tu kya hai

lines: Ragon mein daudte phirne ke hum nahin qaail
couplets.en: Merely coursing through the veins does not convince me.

lines: Jab aankh hi se na tapka, to phir lahu kya hai
couplets.en: If it never falls from the eye, how can it be blood?

lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ke tu kya hai

lines: Rahi na taaqat-e-guftaar, aur agar ho bhi
couplets.en: The strength to speak is gone, and even if it returned.

lines: To kis umeed pe kahiye ke aarzoo kya hai
couplets.en: What hope would there be in saying what I long for?

lines: Har ek baat pe
couplets.en: At every word.

lines: Hua hai shah ka musaahib, phire hai itraata
couplets.en: Made a companion to the king, he goes about full of himself.

lines: Vagarna shahr mein Ghalib ki aabroo kya hai
couplets.en: Otherwise, what standing does Ghalib have in this city?
